claim: Bali and Hovakimian (Management Science 55(11) 2009): the realized-minus-implied volatility spread is negatively related to expected stock returns (volatility-risk proxy); the call-minus-put implied volatility spread is positively related (jump-risk proxy).
impact_on_spec: Fixes the IVRV direction: long stocks whose implied volatility is high relative to realized volatility (iv - RV21 positive). Corrects the reversed direction in I-20261005-03 and the T-20260929-61 plan.
independent_replication: OSAP replicates RIVolSpread (t 2.9, port sort); no independent post-publication test found by T-36c.
limitations: Abstract only (full text not obtained); sample 1996-2004; NYSE stocks per OSAP notes.
quote: 已实现减隐含波动率价差与预期收益负相关（波动率风险代理）；看涨减看跌隐含波动率价差与预期收益正相关（跳跃风险代理）。
market_and_period: US optionable stocks (NYSE per OSAP notes), 1996-2004, monthly

claim: Open Source Asset Pricing signal documentation: RIVolSpread = realized vol (past 30 days) minus ATM implied vol, Sign -1, port-sort t 2.9 (return 0.732%/month), 1996-2004; dVolCall sign +1 (t 3.45), dVolPut sign -1 (t 2.03), dCPVolSpread sign -1 (t 6.77).
impact_on_spec: Independent confirmation of the IVRV sign and the size reference for the power section (IC21 about 0.018-0.026 after T-36c's conversion).
independent_replication: OSAP is itself a replication of the original papers on CRSP/OptionMetrics.
limitations: In-sample replication of the original periods; no post-2011 numbers. Snapshot is a verbatim field extract of the T-36c OSAP SignalDoc rows (the raw JSON contains '<' filter strings that the quote checker strips).
quote: "Acronym": "RIVolSpread", "Authors": "Bali and Hovakimian", "Year": "2009", "LongDescription": "Realized minus Implied Vol", "SampleStartYear": "1996", "SampleEndYear": "2004", "Evidence Summary": "t=3 in port sort", "Key Table in OP": "Table 3 Panel A", "Test in OP": "port sort", "Sign": "-1.0"
market_and_period: CRSP/OptionMetrics replication of the original samples, 1996-2004 (RIVolSpread) and 1996-2011 (IV changes), monthly

claim: An, Ang, Bali and Cakici (JF 2014): stocks with large increases in call implied volatility over the previous month have high future returns and stocks with large increases in put implied volatility have low future returns; decile spreads about 1% per month that persist.
impact_on_spec: Motivates DIV21 and DIV5; because DoltHub's iv_current blends calls and puts, whose changes predict with opposite signs, the direction is taken from the stress window instead of the paper.
limitations: 1996-2011 OptionMetrics, separate call and put surfaces at delta 0.5 and 30 days; our IV is a vendor blend of unknown construction.
quote: Stocks with large increases in call implied volatilities over the previous month tend to have high future returns while stocks with large increases in put implied volatilities over the previous month tend to have low future returns.

claim: Muravyev, Pearson and Pollet (working paper 2022, JFE 2025): option-signal stock return predictability decreases by about two-thirds after returns are adjusted for borrow fees, and by a similar amount if high-fee stocks are excluded.
impact_on_spec: Lowers the priors; L12 names are mostly low-fee, so the measured IC is expected near the post-fee third of the published effect.
limitations: Sample 2006-07..2015-08; working-paper version read, published version not obtained.
quote: we show that abnormal stock return predictability from option signals decreases by about two-thirds after returns are adjusted for borrow fees. The predictability of unadjusted returns decreases by a similar amount if high-fee stocks are excluded.
market_and_period: US optionable stocks with Markit borrow fees, 2006-07..2015-08

claim: Neuhierl, Tang, Varneskov and Zhou (Management Science 72(4) 2026): option information matters, but only a few option characteristics have significant incremental predictive power after controlling for a large set of firm characteristics; the strongest relate to mispricing, tail returns and short-selling costs.
impact_on_spec: Makes the marginal IC against m0_composite and the nine themes a required diagnostic and lowers the prior that a promoted signal adds book-level Sharpe.
limitations: Abstract only; which characteristics survive is not stated in the abstract.
quote: there are only a few option characteristics that have significant incremental predictive power after controlling for the large set of firm characteristics
market_and_period: US optionable stocks; sample period not in the abstract

claim: Walter, Zimmer and Ulrich (arXiv 2609.31263, 2026-09-25): 137 option-implied characteristics for optionable US stocks 2004-2023, screened to 20 factors and tested against 160 equity factors; equity factors explain about 91% of option-factor variance; 4 factors survive Bonferroni (IV convexity, two jump-tail measures, risk-neutral kurtosis); in-sample only.
impact_on_spec: IV-RV and IV changes are not among the survivors, so priors are lowered; the surviving dimensions need the full smile, which only the T-20261005-33 recorder can provide.
limitations: In-sample, no hold-out; read through the fetch tool's extraction of the HTML full text.
quote: In-sample, the equity factors account for about 91% of the option factors' variance, and adding the option factors does not significantly raise the maximum Sharpe ratio.
market_and_period: Optionable US stocks, Feb 2004-Jul 2023, monthly, in-sample
